nodes.label: Notas de caso – Create Note Form UI (Case #4 Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.)
nodes.author: toledolaw
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the 'Notas de caso' (Case Notes) feature in the Captio legal case management app. Shows a note creation form for case #4 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' categorized under 'Negocios / contrato'. The form contains: a Título (title) field with placeholder 'Ej. Estrategia inicial, Pendientes, Resumen de audiencia...'; a 'Notas padre' (parent notes) selector with an existing tag 'Notas de la primera reunión con cliente' already selected, indicating hierarchical/nested note support; a free-text 'Nota' textarea with placeholder 'Escribe aquí...'; and a 'Guardar nota' (Save note) action button. Navigation includes a back arrow to 'Casos' and an 'Opciones' dropdown. The logged-in user is identified as 'toledolaw'. Design uses a light gray card layout on white background, blue primary button, and pill-shaped tag for parent note selection.
